Carte obsolète, embouteillages mal évalués : pourquoi votre GPS peut dérailler

2026-07-25 Aymeric Renou, Le Parisien GPS, TomTom, outdated maps, navigation errors, satellite positioning, camping-car, map updates
Read the source article

Quick summary

A TomTom spokesperson explains that most GPS navigation errors stem from outdated maps rather than satellite positioning issues, with older built-in car systems particularly vulnerable as update mechanisms become obsolete.

Key takeaways

  • Vincent Martinier, TomTom spokesperson, states that "lack of updates is at the origin of most errors" in GPS navigation
  • Built-in car navigation systems are most affected, especially in older vehicles where updates are no longer maintained
  • 15 years ago, updates were done via CD or USB key — now completely obsolete
  • Some models lack sufficient internal memory for modern map updates that require gigabytes of data
  • Smartphone navigation apps offer constant map updates but become blind without mobile internet coverage
